40016241.author: पदार्थः
40016241.content: राक्षसेश्वरः Rakshasa king, अकम्पनवधम् Akampana's death, श्रुत्वा having heard, क्रुद्धः angry, किञ्चित् little, दीनमुखःचअपि with pale face, तान् his, सचिवान् ministers, उदैक्षत looked at.

40016241.author: Translation
40016241.content: The king of Rakshasas hearing about the death of Akampana, was pale and a little angry and looked at his ministers.

40016242.author: पदार्थः
40016242.content: राक्षसाधिपः Rakshasa king, सःरावणः Ravana, मुहूर्तम् for a while, ध्यात्वा reflected, मन्त्रिभिः ministers too, संविचार्यच deliberated, ततः then, पूर्वदिवसे forenoon, सर्वगुल्मान् all posts, अवेक्षितुम् inspect, लङ्कांपुरीम् Lanka city, ययौ proceeded.

40016242.author: Translation
40016242.content: Ravana, the king of Rakshasas, reflected for a while and deliberated with his ministers and proceeded in the forenoon to inspect all posts in Lanka.

40016243.author: पदार्थः
40016243.content: लङ्कां Lanka, राक्षसगणैः by Rakshasa army, गुप्ताम् guarded, बहुभिः many, गुल्मैः posts, आवृताम् surrounded, पताकाध्वजमालिनीम् with rows of flags and posts and pennants तांनगरीम् that city, ददर्श saw.

40016243.author: Translation
40016243.content: Ravana saw Lanka guarded by the Rakshasa army, surrounded by many posts, with flags, posts, and pennants.

40016244.author: पदार्थः
40016244.content: राक्षसेश्वरः Lord of Rakshasas, रावणः Ravana, रुद्धाम् besieged, नगरीम् city, दृष्टवा seeing, काले time, युद्धकोविदम् skilled in warfare, प्रहस्तम् Prahastha, आत्महितम् for his welfare, उवाच spoke.

40016244.author: Translation
40016244.content: Ravana, the Lord of Rakshasas seeing the city besieged, spoke to Prahastha who was skilled in warfare for his welfare.

40016245.author: पदार्थः
40016245.content: युद्धविशारद knowledgeable in war, उपनिविष्टस्य to deliver, सहसा suddenly, पीडितस्य oppressed, पुरस्य city's, युद्धात् from war, अन्यम् others, मोक्षम् can liberate, नप्रवश्यामि not able to know.

40016245.author: Translation
40016245.content: "I am not able to see anyone (other than you) knowledgeable in warfare to deliver the city oppressed suddenly and can liberate from war."

40016246.author: पदार्थः
40016246.content: अहंवा myself, कुम्भकर्णोवा or Kumbhakarna, मम my, सेनापतिः CommanderinChief, त्वंवा or you, इन्द्रजिद्वा Indrajith, निकुम्भोवा or Nikumbha, ईदृशम् such, भारम् burden, वहेयुः undertake.

40016246.author: Translation
40016246.content: "Either myself or Kumbhakarna, or my CommanderinChief, or you, or Indrajith, or Nikumbha can undertake such a burden."

40016247.author: पदार्थः
40016247.content: सःत्वम् you, ततः therefore, शीघ्रम् quickly, बलम् army, आदाय getting, परिगृह्यच taking charge, वनौकसः Vanaras, सर्वे all, यत्र there, विजयाय for conquering, अभिनिर्याहि are collected.

40016247.author: Translation
40016247.content: "Therefore, quickly get ready with the army and take charge for conquering the vanaras collected there."

40016248.author: पदार्थः
40016248.content: निर्याणायादेव as soon as you go, ते they, नूनम् surely, चलिता unsettled, हरिवाहिनी Vanara army, नर्दताम् uproar, राक्षसेन्द्राणाम् Rakshasas, नादम् sound, श्रुत्वा hearing, द्रविष्यति will run.

40016248.author: Translation
40016248.content: As soon as you go there surely the unsettled Vanara army will run away hearing the uproar and loud noise of Rakshasas.

40016249.author: पदार्थः
40016249.content: चपलाः fickle minded, अविनीताश्च undisciplined, चलचित्ताश्च volatile, वानराः Vanaras, द्विपाः glowing, सिंहनादमिव like lions roar, ते you, नादम् sound, नसहिष्यन्ति not endure.

40016249.author: Translation
40016249.content: "Vanaras, who are fickle minded, undisciplined and volatile, will not endure the roar of lions of glowing Rakshasas."

40016250.author: पदार्थः
40016250.content: प्रहस्त Prahastha, तस्मिन् बले your force, विद्रुते knowing, सौमित्रिणासह along with Saumithri, रामः Rama, अवशः surely, निरालम्बः helpless, वशम् fall into your power, एष्यति will be.

40016250.author: Translation
40016250.content: "Prahastha! Knowing your strength, the helpless Vanaras will surely run away and along with Saumithri. Rama will fall into your power."

40016251.author: पदार्थः
40016251.content: अत्र then, संशयिता uncertain, आपत् if it comes, श्रेयः good, निस्सशयीकृता undesirable, न not, तु you, यत् that, वा or, प्रतिलोमानुलोमंवा whether acceptable or not acceptable, हितम् good, मन्यसे I think.

40016251.author: Translation
40016251.content: "If uncertain death comes it is good, not when it comes by not encountering. Think what is acceptable to you and what is not acceptable to you and that is acceptable to me."

40016252.author: पदार्थः
40016252.content: रावणेन by Ravana, एवम् in that way, उक्तः spoken, वाहिनीपतिः CommanderinChief, उशना preceptor of Rakshasas, असुरेन्द्रमिव this way to the king of Rakshasas, राक्षसेन्द्रम् Rakshasa Lord, इदम् thus, उवाच spoke.

40016252.author: Translation
40016252.content: Prahastha, the CommanderinChief having heard Ravana, replied to the king of Rakshasas just as the preceptor of Rakshasas spoke to Bali.

40016253.author: पदार्थः
40016253.content: राजन् O King!, कुशलैः capable, मन्त्रिभिःसह along with ministers, नः is it not, मन्त्रितपूर्वम् earlier, परस्परम् one another, समवेक्ष्य reviewed, नः is it not, विवादश्च controversy, वृत्तः arose.

40016253.author: Translation
40016253.content: "O king! This was deliberated with capable ministers earlier, is it not It was reviewed with one another, and controversy arose."

40016254.author: पदार्थः
40016254.content: सीतायाः Sita, प्रदानेन by giving, मया by me, श्रेयः beneficial, व्यवसितम् if not given, अप्रदानेपुनः not given, नः if not, युद्धम् war, दृष्टमेव foreseen.

40016254.author: Translation
40016254.content: "If Sita is given away it is beneficial and if not given war is foreseen is known to us."

40016255.author: पदार्थः
40016255.content: काले time comes, दानैश्च gifts, मानैश्च honours, विविधैः many, सान्त्वैश्च praises, सततम् always, त्वया by you, पूजितः worshipped, सःअहम् me all of you, तव your, किम् why, नकुर्याम् why will I not do

40016255.author: Translation
40016255.content: "You have always given me gifts, many honours and praises earlier and worshipped me. When time comes why will I not do"

40016256.author: पदार्थः
40016256.content: मे I, जीवितम् life, रक्ष्यम् protection, नहि not only, पुत्रदारधनानिच sons, wife, wealth also, त्वदर्थे will not be spared, युधि in war, जीवितम् life, जुहूषन्तम् willing to give up life, माम् by me, त्वम् for you, पश्य you may see.

40016256.author: Translation
40016256.content: "I do not need to protect my life, sons, wives and wealth also. I am willing to give up my life also in war for you. You will see."

40016257.author: पदार्थः
40016257.content: वाहिनीपतिः O CommanderinChief, प्रहस्तः Prahastha, भर्तारम् protector, रावणम् Ravana, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, पुरतः in front, स्थितान् stood, बलाध्यक्षान् chief of army, इदम् this way, उवाच spoke.

40016257.author: Translation
40016257.content: Prahastha, having submitted to his king Ravana in that way, the CommanderinChief of the army commanded the army that stood before him.

40016258.author: पदार्थः
40016258.content: राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, महाबलम् great army, मे me, समानयत together, काननौकसाम् carnivorous, पक्षिणः birds, मद्बाणाच by my arrows, वेगेन speedily, रणाजिरे to the battlefield, हतानाम् killed, मांसादाः flesh, अद्य they, तृप्यन्तु will be satisfied.

40016258.author: Translation
40016258.content: "Get the great Rakshasa army together with me to the battlefield speedily. By my arrows all the carnivorous birds will be killed and satisfied with the flesh (of Vanaras) today", said Prahastha.

40016259.author: पदार्थः
40016259.content: राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, महाबलम् great army, मे me, समानयत together, काननौकसाम् carnivorous, पक्षिणः birds, मद्बाणाच by my arrows, वेगेन speedily, रणाजिरे to the battlefield, हतानाम् killed, मांसादाः flesh, अद्य they, तृप्यन्तु will be satisfied.

40016259.author: Translation
40016259.content: "Get the great Rakshasa army together with me to the battlefield speedily. By my arrows all the carnivorous birds will be killed and satisfied with the flesh (of Vanaras) today", said Prahastha.

40016260.author: पदार्थः
40016260.content: कृतत्वरा: very soon, बलाध्यक्षाः commander in chief, इत्युक्ता: spoken that way, प्रहस्तेन by Prahastha, तस्मिन् in that way, राक्षसमन्दिरे Rakshasa abode, बलम् troops, उद्योजयामासुः mobilized.

40016260.author: Translation
40016260.content: As soon as the commander in chief ordered in that way, the Rakshasa troops mobilized in the abode of Rakshasas.

40016261.author: पदार्थः
40016261.content: मुहूर्तेन in a short while, सालङ्का that Lanka, गजैरिव of elephant size, भीमैः frightening, तै: they, नानाविधायुधैः different kinds of weapons, तैः they, राक्षसवीरैः Rakshasa warriors, समाकुला gathered, बभूव filled.

40016261.author: Translation
40016261.content: In a short while the whole of Lanka was filled with elephant size Rakshasa warriors gathered with different kinds of weapons.

40016262.author: पदार्थः
40016262.content: हुताशनम् propitiating fire, तर्पयताम् with offerings, ब्राह्मणांश्च to the brahmanas, नमस्यताम् worshipping, आज्यगन्धप्रतिवहः air with fragrance of ghee and flowers, सुरभः very pleasant, मारुतः blew, वनौ past.

40016262.author: Translation
40016262.content: A fragrant breeze blew past there with Rakshasas propitiating fire god, with offerings and by the worshipping of brahmins the air was pleasant filled with the fragrance of ghee and flowers.

40016263.author: पदार्थः
40016263.content: तदा then, सङ्ग्रामसज्जाः military weapons and articles, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, विविधाकाराः of different form, अभिमन्त्रिताः consecrated with chanting, स्रजश्च flower garland s, जगृहुः went, सम्हृष्टाः rejoiced, धरायन् wore.

40016263.author: Translation
40016263.content: Then the Rakshasas rejoiced, wishing victory, consecrated military material with chanting and wore flower garland s.

40016264.author: पदार्थः
40016264.content: सधनुष्काः bows, कवचिनः shields, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, राजानम् to the king, रावणम् Ravana, प्रेक्ष्य looking at, वेगात् swiftly, आप्लुत्य greeting, प्रहस्तम् Prahastha, पर्यवारयन् surrounded.

40016264.author: Translation
40016264.content: Wearing bows and shields, looking at and greeting the king Ravana, they swiftly surrounded Prahastha.

40016265.author: पदार्थः
40016265.content: अथ and then, युक्तः taking leave, प्रहस्तः Prahastha, राजानम् King, आमन्त्य causing, भैरवाम् terrific, भेरीम् drums, आहत्य blowing, सज्जकल्पितम् equipped for fight, महाजवैः of good speed, हयैः horses, युक्तम् driven by, सम्यक् capable, सूतसुसंयुतम् with charioteer, महाजलदनिर्घोषम् sounding like thundering cloud, साक्षात् just as, चन्द्रार्कभास्वरम् shining like sun and moon, उरगध्वज with serpent sign on, दुर्धर्षम् difficult to overpower, सुवरूथम् provided with a wooden fence, स्ववस्करम् as defence against collision, सुवर्णजालसंयुक्तम् covered with net of gold, श्रिया splendour, प्रहसन्तमिव as if laughing, रथम् chariot, आरुरोह ascended.

40016265.author: Translation
40016265.content: Taking leave of the king and causing terrific sound of blowing of drums, Prahastha, ascended, laughing on to a splendorous chariot, equipped to fight, driven by horses endowed with good speed and capable charioteer, sounding like a thundering cloud, shining like the sun and moon, with a sign of serpent on flag, provided with a wooden fence for defence, which was difficult to collide, covered with gold net.

40016266.author: पदार्थः
40016266.content: अथ and then, युक्तः taking leave, प्रहस्तः Prahastha, राजानम् King, आमन्त्य causing, भैरवाम् terrific, भेरीम् drums, आहत्य blowing, सज्जकल्पितम् equipped for fight, महाजवैः of good speed, हयैः horses, युक्तम् driven by, सम्यक् capable, सूतसुसंयुतम् with charioteer, महाजलदनिर्घोषम् sounding like thundering cloud, साक्षात् just as, चन्द्रार्कभास्वरम् shining like sun and moon, उरगध्वज with serpent sign on, दुर्धर्षम् difficult to overpower, सुवरूथम् provided with a wooden fence, स्ववस्करम् as defence against collision, सुवर्णजालसंयुक्तम् covered with net of gold, श्रिया splendour, प्रहसन्तमिव as if laughing, रथम् chariot, आरुरोह ascended.

40016266.author: Translation
40016266.content: Taking leave of the king and causing terrific sound of blowing of drums, Prahastha, ascended, laughing on to a splendorous chariot, equipped to fight, driven by horses endowed with good speed and capable charioteer, sounding like a thundering cloud, shining like the sun and moon, with a sign of serpent on flag, provided with a wooden fence for defence, which was difficult to collide, covered with gold net.

40016267.author: पदार्थः
40016267.content: अथ and then, युक्तः taking leave, प्रहस्तः Prahastha, राजानम् King, आमन्त्य causing, भैरवाम् terrific, भेरीम् drums, आहत्य blowing, सज्जकल्पितम् equipped for fight, महाजवैः of good speed, हयैः horses, युक्तम् driven by, सम्यक् capable, सूतसुसंयुतम् with charioteer, महाजलदनिर्घोषम् sounding like thundering cloud, साक्षात् just as, चन्द्रार्कभास्वरम् shining like sun and moon, उरगध्वज with serpent sign on, दुर्धर्षम् difficult to overpower, सुवरूथम् provided with a wooden fence, स्ववस्करम् as defence against collision, सुवर्णजालसंयुक्तम् covered with net of gold, श्रिया splendour, प्रहसन्तमिव as if laughing, रथम् chariot, आरुरोह ascended.

40016267.author: Translation
40016267.content: Taking leave of the king and causing terrific sound of blowing of drums, Prahastha, ascended, laughing on to a splendorous chariot, equipped to fight, driven by horses endowed with good speed and capable charioteer, sounding like a thundering cloud, shining like the sun and moon, with a sign of serpent on flag, provided with a wooden fence for defence, which was difficult to collide, covered with gold net.

40016268.author: पदार्थः
40016268.content: ततः then, रावणार्पितशासनः by the order of Ravana, रथम् chariot, आस्थाय taking seat, महता great, बलेन army, वृतः surrounded by, तूर्णम् immediately, लङ्कायाः from Lanka, निर्ययौ departed.

40016268.author: Translation
40016268.content: Then, by the order of Ravana, Prahastha set out immediately and departed from Lanka taking a se at in the chariot, surrounded by the great army.

40016269.author: पदार्थः
40016269.content: वाहिनीपतौ CommanderinChief of the army, प्रयाते departed, ततः there, पर्जन्यनिनदोपमः arose sounds, दुन्धुभिनिर्घोषः sounds of kettle drums, वादित्राणाम् blasts of fanfares, निनदःच noise, शङ्खशब्दश्च also sounds of conchs, मेदिनीम् earth, पूरयन्निव filling, शुश्रुवे was heard.

40016269.author: Translation
40016269.content: As the CommanderinChief was going there arose sounds of kettle drums, blasts of fanfares, and noise of blasts of conchs filling the earth was heard.

40016270.author: पदार्थः
40016270.content: भीमरूपाः of fierce appearance, महाकायाः endowed with huge body, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, घोरान् dreadful, स्वरान् voice, निनदन्तः making sound, प्रहस्तस्यः Prahastha's, पुरस्सरा marching:, अग्रतः in front, जग्मुः went.

40016270.author: Translation
40016270.content: Rakshasas of fierce appearance, of huge body size, making dreadful sounds went marching ahead of Prahastha.

40016271.author: पदार्थः
40016271.content: नरान्तक Naranthaka, कुम्भहनुः Kumbhahanu, महानादः Mahanada, समुन्नतः Samunnatha, प्रहस्तसचिवाः Prahastha's adjutants, एते these, तम् with, परिवार्य surrounded, निर्ययुः went.

40016271.author: Translation
40016271.content: Naranthaka, Kumbhahanu, Mahanada, Samunnatha, the adjutants of Prahastha went with him.

40016272.author: पदार्थः
40016272.content: सः he, व्यूढेनेव formed into battle array, सुघोरेण formidable, गजयूथनिकाशेन resembled a herd of elephants, महता huge, बलेन army, वृतः surrounded, पूर्वद्वारात् from the eastern gate, निर्ययौ emerged.

40016272.author: Translation
40016272.content: He, emerged from the eastern gate, surrounded by a huge, formidable army formed into a battlearray, which resembled a herd of elephants.

40016273.author: पदार्थः
40016273.content: कालान्तकयमोपमः Kala, Anthaka and Yama, क्रुद्धः enraged, सःप्रहस्तः that Prahastha, सागरप्रतिमौघेन like an ocean, तेन by that, बलेन forces, वृतः surrounded, निर्ययौ emerged.

40016273.author: Translation
40016273.content: Prahastha emerged in rage surrounded by his forces which was like an ocean that resembled Kala (time spirit), Anthaka (death) and Yama (God of death).

40016274.author: पदार्थः
40016274.content: तस्य by the, निर्याणघेषेण sounds that emerged at departure, नर्दताम् roaring, राक्षसानांच Rakshasas also, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, सर्वभूतानि all beings, विकृतैः unnatural way, स्वरैः tone, विनेदुः shrieked.

40016274.author: Translation
40016274.content: By the sounds of roaring that emerged at the departure of the Rakshasas all beings of Lanka shrieked in unnatural ways.

40016275.author: पदार्थः
40016275.content: मांसशोणितभोजनाः living on flesh and blood, खगाः birds, व्यभ्रम् circled, आकाशम् in the sky, आविश्य reaching, रथंप्रति round the chariot, अपसव्यानि in anticlockwise, मण्डलानि round, चक्रुः went.

40016275.author: Translation
40016275.content: The birds living on flesh and blood reached the sky and circled anticlockwise around the chariot.

40016276.author: पदार्थः
40016276.content: घोराः dreadful, शिवाः jackals, पावकज्वालाः tongues of fire, वम्नत्यः vomiting, ववाशिरे howled, अन्तरिक्षात् from the sky, उल्का meteor, पपात fell, वायुश्च wind blew, परुषम् violent, ववौ wind blew.

40016276.author: Translation
40016276.content: A meteor fell from the sky, the wind blew violently. Jackals howled vomiting tongues of fire.

40016277.author: पदार्थः
40016277.content: अन्योन्यम् one another, अभिसंरब्दाः clashing, नचकाशिरे not shine, रक्षसः Rakshasas, रथस्य chariot's, उपरि top, मेघाश्च like cloud, खरनिर्घोषाः violent like donkeys, रुधिरम् blood, ववृर्षुः rained, पुरःसरान् marching, सिषिचुश्च drenched.

40016277.author: Translation
40016277.content: The planets clashing with one another did not shine. The clouds were violent like donkeys and rained blood on top of the chariot and the marching Rakshasas drenched.

40016278.author: पदार्थः
40016278.content: अन्योन्यम् one another, अभिसंरब्दाः clashing, नचकाशिरे not shine, रक्षसः Rakshasas, रथस्य chariot's, उपरि top, मेघाश्च like cloud, खरनिर्घोषाः violent like donkeys, रुधिरम् blood, ववृर्षुः rained, पुरःसरान् marching, सिषिचुश्च drenched.

40016278.author: Translation
40016278.content: The planets clashing with one another did not shine. The clouds were violent like donkeys and rained blood on top of the chariot and the marching Rakshasas drenched.

40016279.author: पदार्थः
40016279.content: दक्षिणामुखः facing south, केतोः banner, मूर्धनि top, निलीनः surrounded, गृध्रः vulture, अस्य its, उभयतः both, पार्श्वम् sides, तुदन् scratching, समग्राम् entire, श्रियम् prosperity, अहरत् snatched.

40016279.author: Translation
40016279.content: Seeing a vulture sitting on the banner (of Prahastha) facing south scratching both sides, Prahastha became pale as if the entire prosperity had been snatched away.

40016280.author: पदार्थः
40016280.content: सङ्ग्रामम् war, अवगाहतः knower, सूतस्य charioteer, हयसादिनः controlling the horses, सारथेः charioteer, हस्तात् from hand, प्रतोदः whip, अस्य his, बहुशः many times, न्यपतत् slipped.

40016280.author: Translation
40016280.content: A charioteer and knower of controlling the horses, the whip slipped many times from his hand.

40016281.author: पदार्थः
40016281.content: भास्वरा splendour, वसुदुर्लभा that which is difficult, या for, निर्याणश्री disappeared, सा that, मुहूर्तेन moment, ननाश destroyed, हयाश्च even horses, समे even ground, स्खलिताः stumbled.

40016281.author: Translation
40016281.content: The splendour of Prahastha which is difficult to destroy, disappeared at that moment and the horses stumbled on even ground.

40016282.author: पदार्थः
40016282.content: प्रख्यातबलपौरुषम् well known for the valour, अभिनिर्यान्तम् coming towards, तुप्रहस्तम् on the part of Prahastha, नानाप्रहरणा various weapons, कपिसेना monkey army, युधि in war, अभ्यवर्तत stood facing.

40016282.author: Translation
40016282.content: Seeing Prahastha, who is well known for his valour coming towards, for war with various weapons, the monkey army stood facing.

40016283.author: पदार्थः
40016283.content: अथ and then वृक्षान् trees, आरुजतांचैव for the sake of fighting, गुर्वीः heavy, शिलाः rocks, आगृह्णताम् taking hold, हरीणाम् monkeys, सुतुमुलः exceedingly, घोषः tumultuous, समजायत arose.

40016283.author: Translation
40016283.content: And when the monkeys took hold of heavy rocks and trees for fighting exceedingly tumultuous clamor arose.

40016284.author: पदार्थः
40016284.content: नदताम् yelling noise, राक्षसानांच of Rakshasas, गर्जताम् roaring, वानराणांच noise of Vanaras, उभे both, सैन्ये army, प्रमुदिते highly rejoiced, वेगितानाम् seized with speed, समर्थानाम् powerful, अन्योन्यवधकाङ् क्षिणाम् who sought the destruction of one another, परस्परम् one another, आह्वयताम् challenging, रक्षोगणवनौकसाम् armies of Rakshasas and Vanaras, महान् huge, निनादः roar, श्रूयते was heard.

40016284.author: Translation
40016284.content: The yelling noise of Rakshasas and roaring noise of Vanaras of both armies, who were powerful and seized with speed, who sought the destruction of one another, challenging noises of Rakshasas and Vanaras, highly rejoiced, was heard.

40016285.author: पदार्थः
40016285.content: नदताम् yelling noise, राक्षसानांच of Rakshasas, गर्जताम् roaring, वानराणांच noise of Vanaras, उभे both, सैन्ये army, प्रमुदिते highly rejoiced, वेगितानाम् seized with speed, समर्थानाम् powerful, अन्योन्यवधकाङ् क्षिणाम् who sought the destruction of one another, परस्परम् one another, आह्वयताम् challenging, रक्षोगणवनौकसाम् armies of Rakshasas and Vanaras, महान् huge, निनादः roar, श्रूयते was heard.

40016285.author: Translation
40016285.content: The yelling noise of Rakshasas and roaring noise of Vanaras of both armies, who were powerful and seized with speed, who sought the destruction of one another, challenging noises of Rakshasas and Vanaras, highly rejoiced, was heard.

40016286.author: पदार्थः
40016286.content: ततः thereafter, दुर्मतिः perverted, प्रहस्तः Prahastha, कपिराजवाहिनीम् army of monkey king, विजयाय to conquer, प्रहस्तः Prahastha, विवृद्धवेगःच grown immensely, मुमूर्षुः being on the point of death, शलभः moth, विभावसंयथा enters into flame, तांचमूम् that, विवेश entered.

40016286.author: Translation
40016286.content: Thereafter, perverted Prahastha entered into that army of monkey king grown immensely, to conquer the army, just as moth enters into flame, being at the point of death. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेसप्तपञ्चाशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the fifty seventh sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
